input_binding: Exact local document SHA256 and canonical JSON row SHA256; no Git query.
limits: HEAD observes public URL response metadata at a timestamp; it does not verify payload integrity, manifest identity/version, preparation, installation, or runtime.
404/410 establishes public HEAD not-found at observation; a private or hidden asset cannot be distinguished from a removed asset.
Missing Content-Length, HEAD unsupported, access denial, redirect policy, DNS/TLS/network errors, and rate limits are inconclusive, not confirmed missing.
A Content-Length match is metadata agreement only. Redirect queries are used transiently for the HEAD request and never saved.
The optional source commit is a caller label. Actual files read are bound by their recorded SHA256.
